data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate entered 2019 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,231.8m. Management reports that the 2019 underwriting result was materially affected by adverse development on the 2018 and earlier years of account. The prior-year deterioration is primarily attributed to natural catastrophe events (notably the 2016-2018 US and Canada catastrophes and related wildfire events) and adverse development on a number of legacy lines (including exited Open Market Property and re-underwritten Marine Hull and Cargo business). The report does not present a single explicit gross prioryear movement figure; named net impacts are disclosed by calendar year (e.g. net losses of c.GBP 17.9m in 2016, c.GBP 74.6m in 2017 and c.GBP 22.8m in 2018).

data.data_quality_notes: No single explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement for the 2018-and-prior portfolio is printed. The report contains a gross claims development table (triangle) but extracting a definitive PYD requires careful diagonal comparison across multiple development rows and the printed cumulative rows are partially truncated in the available extract. The Managing Agent provides net prior-year impact figures for calendar years (net to syndicate) for some catastrophe years; those net amounts are reported in the narrative but are not a substitute for a gross PYD figure. As a result prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null rather than risk an incorrect gross estimate. A gross claims triangle is present (see page 36) and could be used to calculate PYD, but the extraction was not performed deterministically here.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross cumulative claims development table is present in the report (gross triangle). The extract of the PDF provided contains the triangle but parsing the precise diagonal previous-period values programmatically from the rendered text was ambiguous in places; therefore the development_rows are not supplied here. Use the triangle on page 36 of the report to compute a deterministic gross PYD if required.
